tasks.label: smoke localhost:4000
args: $base='http://localhost:4000'; Write-Output "SMOKE TEST -> $base"; $paths=@('/','/auth/login','/manifest.json','/sw.js','/public/css/modern-design.css'); foreach($p in $paths){ try{ $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($base+$p) -UseBasicParsing -Method GET -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output "OK  $p -> $($r.StatusCode)" } catch { Write-Output "FAIL $p -> $($_.Exception.Message)" } } ; Write-Output 'LISTENERS:'; netstat -ano | Select-String ':4000' | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }

tasks.label: smoke localhost:4000 (node)
args: const http=require('http');const base='http://localhost:4000';const paths=['/','/auth/login','/manifest.json','/sw.js','/public/css/modern-design.css'];function get(p){return new Promise((resolve)=>{const req=http.get(base+p,(res)=>{res.resume();resolve({p,code:res.statusCode});});req.on('error',(e)=>resolve({p,error:e.message}));req.setTimeout(10000,()=>{req.destroy(new Error('timeout'));});});} (async()=>{let fail=false;console.log('SMOKE TEST ->',base);for(const p of paths){const r=await get(p);if(r.error){fail=true;console.log('FAIL',p,'->',r.error);}else{const ok=r.code>=200&&r.code<400;console.log(ok?'OK ': 'BAD',p,'->',r.code);if(!ok) fail=true;}}process.exit(fail?1:0);})();

tasks.label: kill port 4000
args: $pid=(netstat -ano | Select-String ':4000' | Select-String 'LISTENING' | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[-1] } | Select-Object -First 1); if($pid){ Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force; Write-Output "Stopped PID $pid" } else { Write-Output 'No LISTENING PID on :4000' }

tasks.label: kill port 4000 (fixed)
args: $line = (netstat -ano | Select-String ":4000" | Select-String "LISTENING" | Select-Object -First 1 | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }); if ($line) { $pid = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]; Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force; Write-Output ("Stopped PID " + $pid) } else { Write-Output "No LISTENING PID on :4000" }
